escenas.texto: This week in Africa, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and seventeen million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Sunday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from Egypt, HimaVibes Art, with a video posted six days ago. Over five point two million views. A Short of just fifty-six seconds. It also has one hundred and seventy-six comments.
In position number nine, Asmaa Mohamed, with a video posted six days ago. Over five point four million views. It also has over three thousand comments.

At number eight, Bilal Al-Khader, with a video posted five days ago. Over eight point one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-six thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.

At number seven, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over eight point three million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
Number six, from Egypt, Abdelrahman El Desoky _ عبدالرحمن الدسوقي, with a video posted five days ago. Over eight point eight million views. It also has four hundred and twenty-four comments.

Number five, Mr Cristiano, with “PSG 4-2 Barcelona PSG UNBEATEN in the Champions League”. Over nine point three million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-two seconds.
Next up, number four, Ali w rehab علي و رحاب, with a video posted four days ago. Over eleven million views. It also has over one thousand comments.
Bronze medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. Over twelve million views. A Short of just ten seconds. It also has nine hundred and seventy-four comments.

Silver medal, MathMango, with “How Many Folds To Reach The Moon?”. Over fourteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about seventeen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from Egypt, elbezawy, with a video posted four days ago. Over seventeen million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and sixty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about nineteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. At number ten, from Egypt, HikaSIU, with a video posted three days ago. Over one thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nine out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Number nine, from Morocco, Mehdi Hilm, with a video posted one day ago. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over eighty-eight thousand views.

Coming in at number eight, MathMango, with “How Many Folds To Reach The Moon?”. Over one thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about seventeen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

Coming in at number seven, Zack D. Films, with “How Banks Make Money With Your Savings”. Over two thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and thirty thousand views per hour. A Short of just forty-four seconds.

Next up, number six, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over two thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over eight point three million views.
Number five, from Egypt, minaashraf_مينا اشرف , with a video posted three days ago. Over two thousand comments. It also has over two point four million views.
Coming in at number four, Asmaa Mohamed, with a video posted six days ago. Over three thousand comments. It also has over five point four million views.

Bronze medal, from Tunisia, Ury 2, with a video posted two days ago. Over three thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about eighty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It got there in just two days.

Silver medal, AJ+ كبريت, with a video posted six days ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over forty-six minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over three point nine million views.
And finally, number one most commented, from Egypt, عبدالله الشريف Abdullah Elshrif, with a video posted three days ago. Over six thousand comments. It also has over two point three million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Next up, number ten, from Egypt, minaashraf_مينا اشرف , with a video posted three days ago. Over ninety-six thousand likes. It also has over two point four million views.
Number nine, from Egypt, HimaVibes Art, with a video posted six days ago. Over one hundred and seven thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-six seconds. It also has over five point two million views.
Number eight, from Egypt, Abdelrahman El Desoky _ عبدالرحمن الدسوقي, with a video posted five days ago. Over one hundred and eighteen thousand likes. It also has over eight point eight million views.
In position number seven, Asmaa Mohamed, with a video posted six days ago. Over one hundred and forty-one thousand likes. It also has over five point four million views.
Number six, Ali w rehab علي و رحاب, with a video posted four days ago. Over one hundred and eighty-two thousand likes. It also has over eleven million views.

Coming in at number five, MathMango, with “How Many Folds To Reach The Moon?”. Over one hundred and eighty-six thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about seventeen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

At number four, Zack D. Films, with “How Banks Make Money With Your Savings”. Over two hundred and twenty-eight thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and thirty thousand views per hour. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.
Bronze medal, Khaled Pepo, with a video posted five days ago. Over two hundred and ninety-two thousand likes. It also has over five point one million views.
Silver medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. Over three hundred and seven thousand likes. A Short of just ten seconds. It also has over twelve million views.

And finally, number one most liked, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over three hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over eight point three million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Europe. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
